one_line: Mostly sound day; a duplicated GitGuardian story and an overstated take need fixes.

findings.quote: Local coding agents on a Mac no longer need a smaller, weaker model than the hosted option.
findings.instruction: Rewrite the take to claim only what the source supports: a local model now scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified on a 20GB Mac. Drop the comparison to hosted models.

findings.quote: Claude Code's "don't ask again" button has been writing passwords into files that end up on GitHub
findings.instruction: The same GitGuardian story appears in Pulse, in Big Picture (c_de05e7f16c6b1176) and in a Big Picture Apiiro story. Remove the duplicate Big Picture story c_de05e7f16c6b1176 or merge it into the Pulse.

findings.quote: Claude Code's "don't ask again" button has leaked thousands of working passwords onto public GitHub
findings.instruction: This duplicates the Pulse story on the same GitGuardian finding. Drop it from Big Picture.

findings.quote: Hugging Face's own tests put it at least comparable in informal vibe tests, which Hugging Face says need more validation, to Qwen3.8-27B.
findings.instruction: Untangle this sentence and state the hedge once. For example: Hugging Face's informal tests put it comparable to Qwen3.8-27B, though it says they need more validation.

findings.quote: Hugging Face's informal tests put a compressed local multimodal model on par with Qwen3.8-27B for coding.
findings.instruction: The take restates the body and overstates the hedged finding as parity. Replace it with a position the body does not state, and keep the informal-testing caveat.

note: verdict rule: major >= 3 (Three substantive editorial defects is not three fixes, it is a draft that did not come out right. Re-summarise beats patching.) | 1 finding(s) dropped: malformed shape
